title: The quad tree's border walk (FindBorders, AddBorderWaypoint, FillBorder)
effect: type-10 edge cells are placed in a different order or at different nodes
provenance: the walk order depends on heap addresses; the border definition (neighbour and direction) and AddBorderWaypoint 0x0068ADAA are not fully read
authority: libcozmoEngine.so 3.4.0-1204: the border cache key is type<<32|flags, a new entry is dirty (flag byte 1); any node type change or destruction marks every entry dirty; the waypoint is {from, to, dir}, from a type-9 node with a flagged neighbour, walked by a wall-follower; FillBorder inserts a one-point polygon at each de-duplicated from-node centre straight into QuadTreeNode::Insert (0x0068A206; no NaN gate, no Expand), so a level-0 seed becomes one type-10 cell and a merged block four type-10 cells around its centre. FindBorders iterates an unordered_set of node pointers, so the exact waypoint order depends on heap addresses and is not read; kDebugFindBorders (0x00C88160) is unreferenced (the pc-relative pairs at 0x00689AB8, 0x0068ABAC, 0x0068B1EE resolve to 0x00C88161, the empty piecewise_construct_t)

title: The head camera's translation on the robot: RobotHeadCam at (17.52, 0, -8.0) under the neck (-13, 0, 49)
effect: camera geometry for marker pose estimation and head-angle computation
evidence: Robot::Robot 0x0050FF7C..0x0050FFBA builds RobotHeadCam: x = movw/movt 0x418C28F6 (17.52) at 0x0050FF7C, z = `mov.w r1,#0xC1000000` (-8.0) at 0x0050FF8A stored at 0x0050FF8E, passed as r2 = sp+0x48 at 0x0050FFB2 to the Pose3d constructor (PLT 0x4A6C40) with the neck pose at robot+0x2CC as parent; the neck is x = 0xC1500000 (-13.0), z = 0x42440000 (49.0) at 0x0050FF36 and 0x0050FF40 (a Unicorn run of 0x0050FF7C..0x0050FFBA confirmed (17.52, 0, -8.0))
unresolved: R-FIX2 (2026-10-04): found by the verifier of the floor-placement batch: HeadGeometry.HeadCamPositionMm in CameraModel.cs is (17.52, 0, 17.52), the engine's z is -8.0. The engine's value is used only inside TurnTowardsPose.ComputeHeadAngleToSeePose (HeadGeometry.EngineHeadCamPositionMm). Applying it to the vision model moves the camera 25.52 mm lower and three tests that estimate marker poses (CORE005_TheChargerDockingSignalUsesTheMarkersRealShape, NavigationTests.AChargerInViewIsLocalisedWithoutBeingConnected, DriveToObjectWithThePlannerTreatsOtherCubesAsObstaclesButNotTheTarget) then miss by 10-19 mm, because PoseEstimation.cs is a local stand-in for cv::solvePnP (homography init plus Levenberg-Marquardt) that is ill-conditioned for a small near-frontal planar marker. Needs the exact solvePnP and corner pipeline (M11 extraction) before the constant can change; no capture or acceptance bundle contains marker or cube poses, so hardware cannot discriminate 17.52 from -8.0 (the engine binary wins). Not built.
